text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is a field of computer science that creates machines able to perform tasks that normally require human intelligence, such as learning, reasoning, and decision-making. Machine learning is a key part of AI: instead of following fixed instructions, computers learn patterns from data and improve with experience. Deep learning takes this further by using large artificial neural networks to handle complex tasks like image and speech recognition. Today AI is part of our daily lives. It helps recommend films and music, powers voice assistants on our phones, filters spam emails, and supports doctors in making better diagnoses.
